examples.title: PIPE-03: the Jacobian on another grid, fMRIPrep's and the corrected one
examples.summary: fMRIPrep multiplies the unwarped BOLD by a Jacobian, the factor that undoes the intensity pile-up of the distortion. On the BOLD's own grid (above) its factor is right; on another grid (here the MNI152NLin2009cAsym 2 mm grid of the same run) it takes the derivative in the wrong voxels. The factors of ds005040's real field map, against the reference.
